{{Top|leg}}
The '''information Kiosk''' was an automated center in view-screens and holograms that advertised [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] and its services and shops. The kiosk was run by a [[Master-Com]] subsystem that greeted users in an over-polite manner, and answered questions as best it could. It also served as an emergency notification and security observation station when the need arose.
